description: Test suite for bot-related functionalities in Mattermost server, including creating, ensuring, patching, retrieving, disabling, and deleting bots, as well as handling system bots and exemptions from DM restrictions.

methods.name: TestCreateBot
methods.description: Tests for creating bots, including validation and successful creation, and handling username conflicts.

methods.name: TestEnsureBot
methods.description: Tests for ensuring a bot exists, even after deletion, and idempotency of bot creation.

methods.name: TestPatchBot
methods.description: Tests for patching (updating) bot details, including validation and successful updates.

methods.name: TestGetBot
methods.description: Tests for retrieving bots by ID, including handling missing or deleted bots.

methods.name: TestGetBots
methods.description: Tests for listing bots with pagination, filtering by owner, and including/excluding deleted bots.

methods.name: TestUpdateBotActive
methods.description: Tests for enabling/disabling bots and handling unknown bot IDs.

methods.name: TestPermanentDeleteBot
methods.description: Tests for permanently deleting a bot and verifying it no longer exists.

methods.name: TestDisableUserBots
methods.description: Tests for disabling all bots owned by a specific user.

methods.name: TestNotifySysadminsBotOwnerDisabled
methods.description: Tests for notifying sysadmins when a bot owner is deactivated, including message content and bot status updates.

methods.name: TestConvertUserToBot
methods.description: Tests for converting a user to a bot, including validation, session invalidation, and handling OAuth users.

methods.name: TestGetSystemBot
methods.description: Tests for retrieving the system bot, including creation on first retrieval and error handling when no admins exist.

methods.name: TestIsBotExemptFromDMRestrictions
methods.description: Tests for determining if a bot is exempt from direct message restrictions based on ownership, plugin, or system bot status.
